posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Your user folder in Windows has an accent, so you probably downloaded a version that doesn't support UTF-8:
Code:
á
As far as I remember, older Windows command lines only allowed ANSI, but it could be something that wasn't updated in the compiler.
It's rare to see development computers where the username is the user's real name, usually it's USER, USER1 or something related to the user's area of expertise.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
There is no way to change this for a logged in user, you would need to create a new administrator user and this could cause several problems.
The ideal is to change the location of the SDK to a folder outside the USERS folder and give it public permission and give the new path to the compiler
